title: Urological Supply Program Schedule of Free Samples and No-Charge Windows
content:
The Urological Supply Program sends free trial samples of catheters and ships certain replacements at no charge. The quantities, annual counts and windows are scheduled per catheter program as follows.

## Free trial samples

The sample size is the number of catheters sent free as a trial sample before enrollment (units); the annual count is the number of free sample shipments allowed per patient per calendar year.

| Program | Catheters per sample | Sample shipments per calendar year |
|---|---|---|
| Straight Intermittent Catheter Program (A4351) | 10 | 2 |
| Coudé Tip Intermittent Catheter Program (A4352) | 10 | 2 |
| Closed-System Catheter Program (A4353) | 5 | 2 |
| Indwelling Foley Catheter Program (A4338) | 1 | 1 |
| All-Silicone Indwelling Catheter Program (A4344) | 1 | 1 |
| Male External Catheter Program (A4349) | 5 | 2 |

## No-charge windows

| Program | Product switch window (calendar days after the first shipment) | Defect replacement window (calendar days after shipment) | Lost package trace (business days without delivery confirmation) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Straight Intermittent Catheter Program (A4351) | 30 | 30 | 7 |
| Coudé Tip Intermittent Catheter Program (A4352) | 30 | 30 | 7 |
| Closed-System Catheter Program (A4353) | 30 | 30 | 7 |
| Indwelling Foley Catheter Program (A4338) | 30 | 30 | 7 |
| All-Silicone Indwelling Catheter Program (A4344) | 30 | 30 | 7 |
| Male External Catheter Program (A4349) | 30 | 30 | 7 |

- **Product switch window** — calendar days after the first shipment within which one brand or size switch is shipped at no charge: 30.
- **Defect replacement window** — calendar days after shipment within which a defective item is replaced at no charge: 30.
- **Lost package trace** — business days without delivery confirmation after which a lost shipment is reshipped at no charge: 7.

## Schedule notes

- Sample size differs by program: 10 catheters for the two intermittent tip programs, 5 for Closed-System and Male External, and 1 for the two indwelling programs.
- The annual count is 2 sample shipments for four programs and 1 for the Indwelling Foley and All-Silicone programs.
- The three no-charge windows are the same in every program; the lost-package figure counts business days, while the other two count calendar days.
